-- AAC Phase 1I
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.marketing_review_links` (
  marketing_review_link_id STRING NOT NULL,
  article_id STRING NOT NULL,
  secure_token_hash STRING NOT NULL,
  status STRING NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  expires_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  first_opened_at TIMESTAMP,
  responded_at TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TEMP TABLE routed_article AS
SELECT
  a.article_id, a.doctor_id, a.campaign_id, a.current_version,
  c.require_marketing_approval,
  IF(c.require_marketing_approval, 'MARKETING_REVIEW', 'PUBLISHING') AS next_status
FROM `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.articles` a
JOIN `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.campaigns` c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
WHERE a.status IN ('DOCTOR_APPROVED', 'DOCTOR_AUTO_APPROVED')
  AND a.article_id = @article_id
  AND a.practice_id = 'practice_test_001'
ORDER BY COALESCE(a.doctor_approved_at, a.created_at) DESC
LIMIT 1;

UPDATE `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.marketing_review_links`
SET status = 'SUPERSEDED'
WHERE article_id IN (SELECT article_id FROM routed_article WHERE require_marketing_approval)
  AND status IN ('READY', 'OPENED');

CREATE TEMP TABLE new_link AS
SELECT
  GENERATE_UUID() AS marketing_review_link_id, article_id, doctor_id, campaign_id, current_version,
  CONCAT(REPLACE(GENERATE_UUID(), '-', ''), REPLACE(GENERATE_UUID(), '-', '')) AS raw_token,
  TIMESTAMP_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AS expires_at
FROM routed_article
WHERE require_marketing_approval;

INSERT INTO `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.marketing_review_links`
(marketing_review_link_id, article_id, secure_token_hash, status, created_at, expires_at)
SELECT marketing_review_link_id, article_id, TO_HEX(SHA256(raw_token)), 'READY', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), expires_at
FROM new_link;

MERGE `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.approvals` T
USING (
  SELECT GENERATE_UUID() AS approval_id, article_id, 'MARKETING_REVIEW' AS approval_type,
    'PENDING' AS status, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS requested_at, expires_at AS deadline
  FROM new_link
) S
ON T.article_id = S.article_id AND T.approval_type = S.approval_type AND T.status = 'PENDING'
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET requested_at = S.requested_at, deadline = S.deadline, responded_at = NULL, response = NULL
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT
  (approval_id, article_id, approval_type, status, requested_at, deadline)
  VALUES (S.approval_id, S.article_id, S.approval_type, S.status, S.requested_at, S.deadline);

UPDATE `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.articles`
SET status = (SELECT next_status FROM routed_article LIMIT 1)
WHERE article_id IN (SELECT article_id FROM routed_article);

UPDATE `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.campaign_doctors`
SET status = (SELECT next_status FROM routed_article LIMIT 1), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()
WHERE campaign_id IN (SELECT campaign_id FROM routed_article)
  AND doctor_id IN (SELECT doctor_id FROM routed_article);

INSERT INTO `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.workflow_events`
(event_id, entity_type, entity_id, event_type, event_timestamp, source_system, workflow_execution_id, payload)
SELECT GENERATE_UUID(), 'article', article_id,
  IF(require_marketing_approval, 'marketing.review_requested', 'publish.requested'),
  CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 'n8n', NULL,
  TO_JSON(STRUCT(current_version AS version_number, require_marketing_approval))
FROM routed_article;

SELECT
  r.article_id, r.doctor_id, r.campaign_id, r.current_version, r.require_marketing_approval, r.next_status,
  n.marketing_review_link_id, n.expires_at,
  IF(n.raw_token IS NULL, NULL, CONCAT('https://apex-content-interviewer.jdold.workers.dev/marketing-review/', n.raw_token)) AS review_url
FROM routed_article r
LEFT JOIN new_link n USING (article_id, doctor_id, campaign_id, current_version);

## AAC Phase 1I - Marketing Routing

Routes the newest doctor-approved article according to the campaign setting. Required reviews receive a hashed, one-time marketing link and pending approval; campaigns without marketing review advance directly to publishing.

Connect the existing **Google BigQuery account** credential before running.
